content:
We have a news update for you first: Amazon's fall Prime Day deals have started early — AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to US$179 with free shipping, one of the lowest prices we've seen so far.

Although the fall Prime Big Deal Days event is still about 48 hours away from officially kicking off, Amazon has jumped the gun and is now selling Apple's flagship AirPods Pro 3 for US$179 with free shipping.

  • AirPods Pro 3 at US$179 (original price US$249) — one of the best discounts ever

The current retail price for the Pro lineup is US$249. Although we saw it drop to US$199 several times this summer, this time it's been cut even further — a US$70 markdown that makes for a very attractive deal.

Apple recently officially launched the all-new AirPods 5, available in two versions: the base version with ANC active noise cancellation at US$129, and an upgraded version that comes with a wireless charging case. In terms of value for money, the just-launched US$129 base version with ANC is quite competitive, but the model with a wireless charging case will set you back US$149; meanwhile, for just US$30 more, you can get the far more capable AirPods Pro 3.

The Pro 3 offers 3x stronger active noise cancellation, longer battery life, and more advanced health features such as a built-in heart rate sensor and hearing aid functionality. For more details, check out our earlier comparison feature — AirPods Pro 3 vs. AirPods 5.

The US$129 AirPods 5 base version is certainly a solid choice, but the US$179 AirPods Pro 3 offers more comprehensive features and a very attractive discount — and this is a price we've only seen once before today.

This price cut comes just weeks after Apple rolled out a host of new features for the AirPods Pro 3 alongside iOS 27. That update added the long-awaited custom EQ equaliser feature:

Other new features include a brand-new adaptive audio control method, improved Find My integration, and more.
